# gitmoap_repository_tags (Data Source)

List tags in a repository. The repository's tags in name order, ascending by default — or by version, highest first, or newest first — optionally narrowed to names containing a search term (case-insensitive). Each comes with the commit it points to. Page with `next_token`, passed back unchanged with the same sort; a sort other than those listed, or a token this listing did not hand out, is refused.

The token needs `tag:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_tags" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Filter tags by name substring
- `sort` (String) Sort order: name_asc (default), name_desc, version_desc — highest version first, then the tags that are no version — or created_desc, newest first

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
